gem_guidance.text: Note on gemming: In our Phase 3 and Phase 4 BiS guides, Agility gems were recommended as the most efficient default choice due to the sky-high avoidance of Tier 6 geared bears and the increasing returns of avoidance towards survivability. For Phase 5 content, however, stacking Stamina gems once again becomes the optimal choice for survivability due to the Sunwell Radiance aura, which drops the baseline avoidance of Ferals back down to Phase 1 levels and nerfs the overall value of incremental avoidance gains from gems. Another difference in gemming recommendations relative to prior phases is the use of the Powerful Earthstorm Diamond meta gem in place of the previously recommended Relentless Earthstorm Diamond . This is a consequence of deprioritizing TPS relative to survivability for Phase 5 content due to the substantially higher risk of death when tanking Sunwell Plateau bosses compared to prior raid tiers, and also because the simpler color requirements on Powerful Earthstorm Diamond allow you to fit in at least 2 additional Solid Empyrean Sapphire gems than would be possible when gemming to activate Relentless Earthstorm Diamond .

title: Burning Crusade Classic Feral Druid Tank Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 5 Gear Guide - Wowhead
